Legal Compliance

All Plots Approved by Authorised Bodies

Every industrial and residential plot we list is fully approved and regulated by the official development authorities governing Greater Noida and the Yamuna Expressway corridor — ensuring complete legal compliance and peace of mind.

✦ Active Approval

UPSIDA

Uttar Pradesh State Industrial Development Authority

All industrial plots in Greater Noida are developed and approved under UPSIDA's industrial development framework.

Primary Authority
✦ Active Approval

YEIDA

Yamuna Expressway Industrial Development Authority

Governing body for all plots along the Yamuna Expressway corridor — the region's fastest-growing industrial and residential zone.

✦ Active Approval

Noida Development Authority

Noida Industrial Development Authority (NIDA)

Residential plots across Alpha, Beta, Gamma, Delta and Zeta sectors are NDA approved with clear titles.
